method: Local bundled MediaPipe Lite reinference on screen-recorded camera crops; mirrored preview reversed before inference; all frames including missing poses preserved; live filter warmed before stable calibration; exact skill profiles replayed against independently visually annotated complete cycles.
limitations: Compressed recordings contain existing skeleton overlays.
Counts validate these annotated segments only, not general exercise accuracy or physical technique.
Raw recordings, frames and landmarks are private and excluded.
singleLegAnnotation: Three alternating supporting-leg cycles; repeated same-side attempts are excluded after the preceding valid cycle. Foot lifting alone is not a repetition.
